Le glisser-déposer propre au navigateur, sous forme de glissements de la bibliothèque — des fichiers, des liens et du texte venus d'autres applications dans des cibles de dépôt et des listes qui leur font de la place, des items glissés hors de la page, et entre les fenêtres de votre application.
Rend un élément déplaçable — glissement libre, ou vers les cibles de dépôt qui l'acceptent.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider, type ActivationOptions } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import PropRow from './PropRow.vue';
import DensityList from './DensityList.vue';

const ACTIVATIONS: Record<string, ActivationOptions | undefined> = {
  default: undefined,
  '{ mouse: { delay: 300 } }': { mouse: { delay: 300, tolerance: 5 } },
};

const overlayFit = ref<'slot' | 'source'>('slot');
const activation = ref('default');
const keyboard = ref<'true' | 'false'>('true');
const copyModifier = ref<'Alt' | 'Shift' | 'null'>('Alt');

// The provider reads its props when it needs them: a change applies to the next drag.
const props = computed(() => ({
  overlayFit: overlayFit.value,
  activation: ACTIVATIONS[activation.value],
  // `false` turns keyboard drags off; an object sets their keys and steps.
  keyboard: keyboard.value === 'true' ? undefined : (false as const),
  copyModifier: copyModifier.value === 'null' ? null : copyModifier.value,
}));

const compact = ref([
  { id: 'copy', title: 'Write copy' },
  { id: 'login', title: 'Fix login' },
]);
const roomy = ref([
  { id: 'sprint', title: 'Plan the sprint' },
  { id: 'review', title: 'Review the PR' },
]);
</script>

<template>

        <PropRow v-model="overlayFit" name="overlay-fit" :options="['slot', 'source']" />
        <PropRow v-model="activation" name=":activation" :options="Object.keys(ACTIVATIONS)" />
        <PropRow v-model="keyboard" name=":keyboard" :options="['true', 'false']" />
        <PropRow v-model="copyModifier" name="copy-modifier" :options="['Alt', 'Shift', 'null']" />
      </div>
      <div class="lists">
        <DensityList v-model="compact" title="Compact" compact />

import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';

});

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import ColumnList from './ColumnList.vue';

const columns = ref(['Name', 'Status', 'Owner', 'Due date', 'Priority']);

const dialog = useTemplateRef<HTMLDialogElement>('dialog');
const open = ref(false);
const intoDialog = ref(true);

// A modal <dialog> sits on the top layer, above everything in <body>, the overlay
// included. While it is open, the overlay renders inside it.
const overlayTo = computed(() => (open.value && intoDialog.value ? '#columns-dialog' : 'body'));

const show = () => {
  dialog.value?.showModal();
  open.value = true;
};
</script>

<template>
  <DnDProvider :overlay-to="overlayTo">
    <div class="sheet">
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th v-for="column in columns" :key="column">{{ column }}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr v-for="row in 2" :key="row">
            <td v-for="column in columns" :key="column"><span class="skeleton" /></td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <button type="button" class="primary" @click="show">Edit columns</button>
    </div>

    <dialog id="columns-dialog" ref="dialog" @close="open = false">
      <h3>Columns</h3>
      <p>Drag to change their order.</p>
      <ColumnList v-model:columns="columns" />
      <footer>
        <label class="switch">
          <input v-model="intoDialog" type="checkbox" />

        </label>
        <button type="button" class="primary" @click="dialog?.close()">Done</button>
